articles.summary: Hilltop Securities Inc. (HilltopSecurities) has released the results of its third annual Public Finance Leaders Survey, which indicate that public entities have entered a period of accelerating technological change while many of government’s traditional constraints remain firmly in place. The complete survey results are available here . The annual survey is designed to gauge the sentiment of public finance leaders across the nation and highlight the priorities, challenges, and opportunities they are facing. articles.title: Public Finance Leaders Embrace Innovation While Capacity Constraints Persist, 2026 HilltopSecurities Survey Finds

articles.summary: Hilltop Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HTH) (“Hilltop”) today announced financial results for the third quarter of 2026. Hilltop produced income attributable to common stockholders of $24.9 million, or $0.44 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $45.8 million, or $0.74 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025. articles.summary: Hilltop Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HTH) (“Hilltop”), a Dallas-based financial holding company, will host a live webcast and conference call at 8:00 AM Central (9:00 AM Eastern) on Friday, October 23, 2026. Hilltop Chairman, President and CEO Jeremy B. Ford and Hilltop CFO William B. Furr will review third quarter 2026 financial results. Interested parties can access the conference call by dialing 833-461-5787 (Toll Free North America) or (+1) 585-542-9983 (International Toll) and then using the conference ID 203160733. The conference call also will be webcast simultaneously on Hilltop’s Investor Relations website ( http://ir.hilltop.com ). About Hilltop Holdings Inc. Hilltop Holdings is a Dallas-based financial holding company. Its primary line of business is to provide business and consumer banking services from offices located throughout Texas through PlainsCapital Bank.
